SELECT MEMBER_ID, GRADE_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, CREATED_AT, PHONE, ROLE, MEMBER_STATUS, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_STR, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR FROM MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, GRADE_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, M.CREATED_AT, PHONE, ROLE, MEMBER_STATUS,P.POINT, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_STR, TO_CHAR(M.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPONHISTORY H LEFT JOIN COUPON C ON H.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = H.MEMBER_ID AND SYSDATE <= C.DEADLINE AND H.TYPE='ISSUE') AS COUPON_QTY FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBERPOINT P ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
